title: Rish Loo
subtitle: Traitorous Minister
text:
Hidden
When Played: Take control of an enemy non‑leader unit with a Weakness token on it. At the start of the next regroup phase, its owner takes control of it.
rules:
If a unit has Hidden and Sentinel at the same time, it can be attacked.
If you take control of a unit, its owner takes control of it at the start of the next regroup phase, even if Rish Loo leaves play.
